# The Project's directory, where its sources are (the Project's paths are relative to it).
get_filename_component(_cppbuild_project_dir "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../../ECOSTL" ABSOLUTE)

_cppbuild_collect_sources(_cppbuild_sources _cppbuild_modules "src" "include")

set(_cppbuild_requested)
set(_cppbuild_used_links)
set(_cppbuild_display OFF)
foreach(_cppbuild_item IN LISTS CPPBUILD_REQUESTED)
  if(_cppbuild_item STREQUAL "DISPLAY")
    set(_cppbuild_display ON)
  elseif(_cppbuild_item MATCHES "^DISPLAY_(.+)$")
    list(APPEND _cppbuild_requested ${CMAKE_MATCH_1})
  else()
    list(APPEND _cppbuild_requested ${_cppbuild_item})
    list(APPEND _cppbuild_used_links ${_cppbuild_item})
  endif()
endforeach()
list(REMOVE_DUPLICATES _cppbuild_requested)

set(ECOSTL_ECOSTL_TYPE "" CACHE STRING "ECOSTL library type: empty = STATIC (SHARED with BUILD_SHARED_LIBS) and each link keeps its saved type; STATIC or SHARED also switch every static/shared link; INTERFACE = header-only use")
set_property(CACHE ECOSTL_ECOSTL_TYPE PROPERTY STRINGS "" STATIC SHARED INTERFACE)
if(NOT "${ECOSTL_ECOSTL_TYPE}" MATCHES "^(|STATIC|SHARED|INTERFACE)$")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "ECOSTL_ECOSTL_TYPE must be empty, STATIC, SHARED or INTERFACE")
endif()

# Types to create: the selected type at the top level, and every type requested by links.
set(_cppbuild_choice "${ECOSTL_ECOSTL_TYPE}")
if(NOT _cppbuild_choice AND BUILD_SHARED_LIBS)
  # CMake's standard switch, when this library has no choice of its own.
  set(_cppbuild_choice SHARED)
endif()
set(_cppbuild_selected STATIC)
if(_cppbuild_choice)
  set(_cppbuild_selected ${_cppbuild_choice})
endif()
set(_cppbuild_types)
set(_cppbuild_used_types)
if(CPPBUILD_WHOLE_SOLUTION)
  list(APPEND _cppbuild_used_types ${_cppbuild_selected})
endif()
if(CPPBUILD_WHOLE_SOLUTION OR _cppbuild_display)
  list(APPEND _cppbuild_types ${_cppbuild_selected})
endif()
foreach(_cppbuild_type IN LISTS _cppbuild_requested)
  set(_cppbuild_link_${_cppbuild_type} ${_cppbuild_type})
  if(_cppbuild_type MATCHES "^(STATIC|SHARED)$" AND "${_cppbuild_choice}" MATCHES "^(STATIC|SHARED)$")
    set(_cppbuild_link_${_cppbuild_type} ${_cppbuild_choice})
  endif()
  list(APPEND _cppbuild_types ${_cppbuild_link_${_cppbuild_type}})
  if(_cppbuild_type IN_LIST _cppbuild_used_links)
    list(APPEND _cppbuild_used_types ${_cppbuild_link_${_cppbuild_type}})
  endif()
endforeach()
list(REMOVE_DUPLICATES _cppbuild_types)
set(_cppbuild_target_STATIC ECOSTL_ECOSTL)
set(_cppbuild_target_SHARED ECOSTL_ECOSTL_shared)
set(_cppbuild_target_INTERFACE ECOSTL_ECOSTL_interface)
set(_cppbuild_plain_output STATIC)
if(_cppbuild_selected STREQUAL "SHARED")
  set(_cppbuild_plain_output SHARED)
endif()

if(STATIC IN_LIST _cppbuild_types)
  add_library(ECOSTL_ECOSTL STATIC ${_cppbuild_sources})
  set(_cppbuild_output "ECOSTL")
  if(SHARED IN_LIST _cppbuild_types AND NOT _cppbuild_plain_output STREQUAL "STATIC")
    set(_cppbuild_output "ECOSTL-static")
  endif()
  set_target_properties(ECOSTL_ECOSTL PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME ${_cppbuild_output})
  target_include_directories(ECOSTL_ECOSTL PUBLIC "${_cppbuild_project_dir}/include")
  target_compile_options(ECOSTL_ECOSTL PUBLIC "$<$<COMPILE_LANG_AND_ID:CXX,MSVC>:/utf-8;/Zc:__cplusplus>" "$<$<COMPILE_LANG_AND_ID:C,MSVC>:/utf-8>")
  if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(ECOSTL_ECOSTL PRIVATE "$<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C,CXX>:/W3>")
  endif()
  set_target_properties(ECOSTL_ECOSTL PROPERTIES CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
  if(DEFINED ECOSTL_ECOSTL_CXX_STANDARD)
    set_target_properties(ECOSTL_ECOSTL PROPERTIES CXX_STANDARD ${ECOSTL_ECOSTL_CXX_STANDARD})
  endif()
  if(ECOSTL_ECOSTL_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY)
    set_target_properties(ECOSTL_ECOSTL PROPERTIES
      RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${ECOSTL_ECOSTL_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}"
      LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${ECOSTL_ECOSTL_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}"
      ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${ECOSTL_ECOSTL_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}"
      PDB_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${ECOSTL_ECOSTL_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}"
    )
  endif()
  set_property(GLOBAL APPEND PROPERTY CPPBUILD_COMPILED_TARGETS ECOSTL_ECOSTL)
  if(_cppbuild_modules)
    if(CMAKE_VERSION VERSION_LESS 3.28)
      message(FATAL_ERROR "ECOSTL_ECOSTL has C++ module interface units, which need CMake 3.28 or later")
    endif()
    target_sources(ECOSTL_ECOSTL PUBLIC FILE_SET cppbuild_modules TYPE CXX_MODULES
      BASE_DIRS "${_cppbuild_project_dir}" FILES ${_cppbuild_modules})
    set_property(GLOBAL APPEND PROPERTY CPPBUILD_MODULE_TARGETS ECOSTL_ECOSTL)
  endif()
endif()

if(SHARED IN_LIST _cppbuild_types)
  add_library(ECOSTL_ECOSTL_shared SHARED ${_cppbuild_sources})
  set(_cppbuild_output "ECOSTL")
  if(STATIC IN_LIST _cppbuild_types AND NOT _cppbuild_plain_output STREQUAL "SHARED")

  set_target_properties(ECOSTL_ECOSTL_shared PROPERTIES WINDOWS_EXPORT_ALL_SYMBOLS ON)

  if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(ECOSTL_ECOSTL_shared PRIVATE "$<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C,CXX>:/W3>")
  endif()
  set_target_properties(ECOSTL_ECOSTL_shared PROPERTIES CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
  if(DEFINED ECOSTL_ECOSTL_CXX_STANDARD)
    set_target_properties(ECOSTL_ECOSTL_shared PROPERTIES CXX_STANDARD ${ECOSTL_ECOSTL_CXX_STANDARD})

  if(ECOSTL_ECOSTL_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY)
    set_target_properties(ECOSTL_ECOSTL_shared PROPERTIES
      RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${ECOSTL_ECOSTL_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}"
      LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${ECOSTL_ECOSTL_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}"
      ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${ECOSTL_ECOSTL_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}"
      PDB_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${ECOSTL_ECOSTL_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}"
    )
  endif()
  set_property(GLOBAL APPEND PROPERTY CPPBUILD_COMPILED_TARGETS ECOSTL_ECOSTL_shared)

    target_sources(ECOSTL_ECOSTL_shared PUBLIC FILE_SET cppbuild_modules TYPE CXX_MODULES

  endif()

  add_library(ECOSTL_ECOSTL_interface INTERFACE)

foreach(_cppbuild_type IN LISTS _cppbuild_requested)
  string(TOLOWER ${_cppbuild_type} _cppbuild_suffix)
  add_library(ECOSTL::ECOSTL_${_cppbuild_suffix} ALIAS ${_cppbuild_target_${_cppbuild_link_${_cppbuild_type}}})

if(TARGET ${_cppbuild_target_${_cppbuild_selected}})
  add_library(ECOSTL::ECOSTL ALIAS ${_cppbuild_target_${_cppbuild_selected}})
endif()
# Types only listed for the IDE, or linked only by such Projects, are not built by default.
foreach(_cppbuild_type IN LISTS _cppbuild_types)
  if(NOT _cppbuild_type IN_LIST _cppbuild_used_types)
    set_target_properties(${_cppbuild_target_${_cppbuild_type}} PROPERTIES EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL ON EXCLUDE_FROM_DEFAULT_BUILD ON)
    if(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY AND CPPBUILD_LINKED_OUTPUT AND NOT ECOSTL_ECOSTL_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY)
      # Programs of different Solutions may share a file name.
      set_target_properties(${_cppbuild_target_${_cppbuild_type}} PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/${CPPBUILD_LINKED_OUTPUT}")
    endif()
  endif()
endforeach()

  source_group(TREE "${_cppbuild_project_dir}" PREFIX "" FILES ${_cppbuild_sources} ${_cppbuild_modules})
